messages:
Sam: quick question — should free tier use hard fallback to smaller model or soft degrade with 503+default model? We need clear console UX for customers.
Priya: soft degrade preferred; customers shouldn't see 500. Prefer fallback to quantized variant + banner in console.
Diego: telemetry wise we need per-tenant metrics: fallback_count, avg_fallback_latency, fallback_ratio. Console needs alerting when fallback_ratio > 5% for 1h.
Alex: agree. Also rate limits vs quota: free tier wants a burst window; when quota breached, we should do soft throttle not full block for 5m grace.
Sam: ok — proposal: policy per tier with fields: allowed_models[], fallback_order[], quota_action {soft_throttle|hard_block}, grace_window_s
Priya: can you paste an example policy JSON?
Sam: pasted
```json
{
  "tier": "free",
  "allowed_models": ["gpt-neo-2.7b-8bit", "gpt-neo-2.7b-q"],
  "fallback_order": ["gpt-neo-2.7b-q", "gpt-mini-8bit"],
  "quota_action": "soft_throttle",
  "grace_window_s": 300
}
```
Diego: looks fine. Implementation note: runtime needs to emit 'route_decision' with reason tag (quota, capacity, variant_unavailable) and selected_model in trace so console can show per-request drilldown.
Alex: UX: console banner text should be templatable by tier + reason. E.g., \"You're on free plan: serving on quantized variant to preserve performance\" with link to docs.
Priya: Rollout plan: enable for non-prod first, then 10% of production requests for 48h, monitor fallback_ratio and error_rate.
Sam: telemetry dashboard items: fallback_ratio (per-tenant, per-region), avg_latency_by_variant, cost_per_token_estimate, rollback_flag
Diego: also surface 'fallback_latency_penalty' = avg(fallback_latency - preferred_latency).
Alex: question about enforcement: soft_throttle should return 429 with Retry-After or stream partial tokens? Which do we prefer?
Priya: 429 + Retry-After simpler; streaming partial outputs is messy and inconsistent.
Sam: agreed. But for chat streaming we can inject a short system message when we fall back: \"Note: using fast quantized model for latency.\" and set header X-Model-Variant.
eng-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout to 10% starting 2025-02-12T03:00Z
Diego: Need flag to opt tenants into 'rigid' mode where they get hard_block instead. Enterprise might want that.
Priya: add 'override_policy' per-tenant with admin_console toggle.
Sam: ok I'll file a PR for policy schema + console changes. I'll include sample dashboard panels and the canary plan.
Alex: thanks. If you need help with backend telemetry hooks I can pair with you tomorrow.
Sam: awesome. I'll ping when PR up. :thumbsup:
